tasks.title: Fix model priority bug in acp-session.ts
tasks.description: In both createAcpOneshotSession (single-round, ~L605) and createMultiRoundAcpSession (multi-round, ~L1124), wrap the config model `setSessionConfigOption` block in a `if (!model)` guard so that per-issue model is not overwritten by config.opencode.model or config.opencode.stageModels. When `model` (per-issue) is already set, skip the entire configuredModel block (validation + setSessionConfigOption).
acceptanceCriteria: When model param is set, setSessionConfigOption is called exactly once (with the per-issue model)
When model param is null/undefined and config.opencode.model is set, setSessionConfigOption is called once (with the config model)
When model param is null/undefined and config.opencode.stageModels[stage] is set, setSessionConfigOption is called once (with the stage model)
When all model sources are absent, setSessionConfigOption is not called
Both single-round (~L605) and multi-round (~L1124) paths are fixed
Build passes (npm run build in packages/cli)
tasks.notes: The fix is a simple guard: wrap the `if (configuredModel) { ... }` block (both paths) with `if (!model) { ... }`. The per-issue model block (`if (model) { ... }`) remains unchanged.

tasks.title: Create opencode-model-config API routes
tasks.description: Create `packages/cli/src/api/opencode-model-config.ts` with GET and PUT handlers for `/model`. GET reads `load().opencode?.model ?? null`. PUT validates body (`{ model: string | null }`), reads config via `load()`, sets/clears `config.opencode.model`, writes via `writeConfig()` with optimistic locking. Handle `ConfigConflictError` → 409. Register router at `/api/opencode-config` prefix in server/index.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/opencode-config/model returns { success: true, data: { model: <string|null> } }
PUT /api/opencode-config/model with { model: "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4" } writes to config.jsonc
PUT /api/opencode-config/model with { model: null } clears opencode.model from config.jsonc
PUT with missing model field returns 400
PUT with non-string/non-null model returns 400
Optimistic lock conflict returns 409
Router registered in server/index.ts
Build passes (npm run build in packages/cli)
tasks.notes: Follow the pattern in api/providers.ts for load()/writeConfig() with ConfigConflictError handling. Register as `server.addRouter('/api/opencode-config', createOpencodeModelConfigRoutes())` in server/index.ts — using a separate prefix to avoid collision with the existing `PUT /:key` catch-all in `/api/config` router.

tasks.title: Add frontend API methods and hooks for opencode model config
tasks.description: Add `getOpencodeModel` and `updateOpencodeModel` methods to `api.ts`. Add `useOpencodeModel` query hook and `useUpdateOpencodeModel` mutation hook to `useQueries.ts`. Also add a `useOpencodeModels` hook that fetches `/opencode/models` (string[]) for the settings selector.
acceptanceCriteria: api.getOpencodeModel() calls GET /api/opencode-config/model and returns { model: string|null }
api.updateOpencodeModel(model) calls PUT /api/opencode-config/model with { model }
useOpencodeModel() returns useQuery wrapping getOpencodeModel
useUpdateOpencodeModel() returns useMutation wrapping updateOpencodeModel with cache invalidation
useOpencodeModels() returns useQuery fetching GET /opencode/models → string[]
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The useOpencodeModels hook fetches from the existing /opencode/models endpoint (already registered in server). This is separate from the existing useModels hook which fetches /providers/models.

tasks.title: Add Default Coder Model selector to GeneralSettingsSection
tasks.description: Add a model selector field to GeneralSettingsSection.tsx after the existing numeric fields and before the divider. Use Popover-based dropdown with search (inline, simplified version of IssueModelSelector pattern). Data: useOpencodeModel for current value, useOpencodeModels for model list, useUpdateOpencodeModel for saving. Show skeleton while loading, display model name or 'opencode default' placeholder, support clear action.
acceptanceCriteria: Field appears after Poll Interval and before the divider/reset button
Displays current model name (last segment after /) when configured
Displays 'opencode default' placeholder when model is null
Shows skeleton loading state while data loads
Clicking opens dropdown with searchable model list from /opencode/models
Selecting a model calls PUT /api/opencode-config/model and updates display
Clear button visible when model is set, calls PUT with { model: null }
Error state shows error message and reverts to previous value
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use Popover from @headlessui/react (already a dependency). The selector is simpler than IssueModelSelector: no recent models, no provider grouping, just a flat searchable list of model strings.

tasks.title: Update IssueModelSelector to show default model name
tasks.description: Add a useOpencodeModel query inside IssueModelSelector.tsx. Update the `currentModelDisplay` logic: when no per-issue model is set, show the default model name (last segment) instead of 'Use default'. Update the clear button label from 'Use default' to 'Use default (model-name)' when a default model is configured. Fall back to 'Use default' when loading or when default is null.
acceptanceCriteria: When per-issue model is null and default model is 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4', trigger button shows 'claude-sonnet-4'
When per-issue model is set and default model is 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4', clear button shows 'Use default (claude-sonnet-4)'
When default model is null, clear button shows 'Use default' (unchanged behavior)
While default model is loading, button shows 'Use default' (no blocking)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Import useOpencodeModel from hooks/useQueries. Extract display name helper: `const displayName = (id: string) => id.split('/').pop() || id`. Keep the change minimal — only touch the display logic, no structural changes to IssueModelSelector.
